about: A free offline file converter for Windows for documents, images, audio and video.

prs.title: Optimizing Word and PowerPoint files keeps transparent images
prs.broken: Shrinking a Word or PowerPoint file turned transparent images, like logos, icons and signatures, black where they should be see-through. With backups off, the damaged file replaced the original.
prs.changed: Images with transparency are now left as they are. Other images are still compressed as before.
prs.matters: People can make documents smaller without ruining their logos and signatures.

prs.title: JSON to CSV works when records have different fields
prs.broken: Turning a JSON list into CSV failed with an error when a later record had a field the first one did not. No CSV file was written at all.
prs.changed: The columns now come from every record, in the order they first appear. Records missing a field get an empty cell.
prs.matters: Exported data with optional fields, which is very common, now converts instead of failing.

prs.title: CSV to JSON reads files saved by Excel correctly
prs.broken: Both CSV formats Excel saves came out wrong. One left a hidden mark on the first column name, the other turned accented letters like é into garbage, and both reported success.
prs.changed: The converter now tries the text encodings Excel uses, in order, and removes the hidden mark.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets saved from Excel convert to clean JSON with the right names and letters.
